description: Stores a model's JSON reply to a batch of memory work, with its work token. The server applies it with its own code: extraction replies are grounded against the text it handed out, resolved and committed; attribute classifications update the vocabulary; verdicts link identical entities or supersede the losing fact; scene summaries and belief sentences are validated and written; an image's reading is stored with the image and read into facts. An item whose evidence changed since it was handed out is skipped and counted stale, so a batch applied twice changes nothing the second time. Returns counts for the batch. A bad, expired or foreign token is refused.

result.description: The reply object, matching the schema
